changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Keep Mark Paid on the accounting reimbursement path; approval/admin roles must not inherit expense:pay.
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM "${schema}".role_permission role_permission USING "${schema}".role tenant_role, "${schema}".permission permission WHERE role_permission.role_id = tenant_role.id AND role_permission.permission_id = permission.id AND permission.resource = 'expense' AND permission.action = 'pay' AND tenant_role.is_deleted = false AND UPPER(TRIM(tenant_role.name)) IN ('HR_ADMIN', 'TENANT_ADMIN', 'ORG_ADMIN', 'LINE_MANAGER', 'MANAGER');

changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Collapse duplicate leave policies before adding the tenant/type uniqueness guard; keep the most recently updated policy row.
changeSet.sql:
WITH ranked_policy AS ( SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY tenant_id, leave_type_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC ) AS row_rank FROM "${schema}".leave_policy ) DELETE FROM "${schema}".leave_policy leave_policy USING ranked_policy WHERE leave_policy.id = ranked_policy.id AND ranked_policy.row_rank > 1;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_leave_policy_tenant_type ON "${schema}".leave_policy (tenant_id, leave_type_id);
